Title: We’re retiring Classic Application Insights on 29 February 2024

Body.Content:
Because the workspace-based Application Insights enhances your monitoring experience, we retire the classic Application Insights on 29 February 2024. We encourage you to start using the workspace-based Applications Insights and take advantage of the enhanced capabilities:  

  • Data encryption at rest with Customer Managed Keys 
  • Capacity Reservation with discounted pricing 
  • Continuous Export of App Logs to Azure Storage/Event Hub via Diagnostic Settings 

Recommended action 

To minimize disruption to your existing application monitoring scenarios, transition to workspace-based Application Insights before 29 February 2024.
